data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek words 'leos' (lion) and 'elandon' (land). Leeland represents a strong and divine connection to the land, symbolizing courage, protection, and faith. The name Leeland carries the meaning “Land of God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Leeland usually hope their child will grow to embody land of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
